name: simple-progress-bars
description: Progress bars with time estimates for long scripts that Claude runs. Scripts report with one command: claude-progress 17/240.

maxRows.title: Most rows of bars
maxRows.description: Tasks that do not fit show as +N.

minSeconds.title: Shortest script for a bar (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Claude adds progress reports only to scripts it expects to run at least this long.
